# v1 - Adversarial post-execution review before the live migration

A fresh agent that is neither the lead nor the executor reads the whole delivery. The review gates
the live migration on purpose: r1 runs the shipped command across twenty-three roadmap files in
the owner's stores, and a writer bug found after that run is a bug found in the owner's data. The
diff also touches `report_screen.rb`, `roadmap_queue.rb`, and `scripts/doctor.rb`, all of which
other commands read, and `installer_core.rb`, which decides what an install ships.

## Criteria
- Every matrix row across n1 to n7 and n9 has a test that fails against the code as it stood
  before that row's fix, not a test that merely passes today. Spot-probe at least five rows by
  reverting the code and watching the named test go red.
- `RoadmapGraph` parses edges only through `GraphEdges` and computes batches and critical paths
  only through `ReadySet`, and `roadmap_queue.rb` no longer contains a second graph reader, a
  second topological sort, a second unnamed-entry fold, or a second unlisted-id report. D1 is true
  on inspection of the whole diff, not only of the new file.
- A render of an unchanged roadmap file changes no bytes, proven against real roadmap files copied
  from the store into a temp directory, including `graph-ready-plastic.md` with its kill-gate
  paragraphs inside `## Batches` and `standalone-agent.md` with its ten unparseable entry lines.
- No roadmap or INDEX write in the diff reaches `File.write` directly. Every one goes through
  `AtomicWrite`, and the interrupted-rename case leaves the original intact with no temp behind.
- The migration never overwrites an existing `## Graph` and refuses `chat-shell-maturity.md`,
  whose heading begins `## Graph` without matching exactly. Both proven against temp copies.
- The dispatchable order for every live roadmap is unchanged before and after a migration, or the
  one difference the plan review measured on `chat-shell-maturity.md` is now absent because file
  order is preserved within a batch.
- `--write` on the real plastic store's INDEX would demote no Completed intent whose ledger is
  silent, proven against a temp copy of the real INDEX.md and the real store, and `## Clusters`
  and `## Relocated` come back byte-identical.
- `RuleCatalog::EXCLUDABLE_CHECKS` is unchanged, and the new drift finding is emitted from
  `check_done_signals` rather than from `doctor_core.rb`.
- Nothing in the diff makes an existing command write INDEX.md, render a roadmap, or migrate as a
  side effect. D10 holds on inspection of every changed call site.
- Every new script and library is registered in `CORE_FILES`, and the `screen_width_test` census
  is re-derived rather than loosened.
- The tree renderer emits no escape byte and its output is byte-identical across two runs.
- `ruby bin/test` is green on the branch with zero failures and zero errors, at or above the
  3778-run baseline this delivery started from.
